newsitem.title: USA: Miami Airport says cargo rose 7.9 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Miami Airport says cargo rose 7.9 pct in 1996.

text.p: Cargo volumes at Miami International Airport rose 7.9 percent to more than 1.8 million tons in 1996, according to statistics compiled by the Dade County Aviation Department.
"We have been working hard to strengthen our cargo trade with South America," a MIA spokesman said.
Total cargo, including mail, hit 1.885 million tons. International cargo was up 6.76 percent during 1996 to 1.508 million tons. Domestic cargo was up 12.7 percent to 377,000 tons.

For the month of December, all cargo, including mail was 164,550, an increase of 7.90 percent from the last month of 1995. International cargo was 133,255, up 6.76 percent and domestic cargo was 31,284 tons, up 12.74 percent in December 1996 over the smae month of 1995.
MIA officials are predicting another strong year for cargo, and expect international cargo to top 1.7 million tons this year. -- Miami News bureau, 305-374-5013
